messages:
Rory (CS): Heads-up: Emberlytics onboarding showed a drop in accepted answers (~17%) and a few slow replies. Renewal check in 5 weeks. Proposal: run a targeted canary routing low-risk intents to rdx-mini-int8, keep escalation flows on rdx-full. Thoughts? :thinking:
Kai (Eng): Noted. Observed p95 spikes during multi-turn sessions. Quick window:
```
p50: 200ms
p95: 700ms
requests: 9.1k
```
Kai (Eng): Plan: 1% -> 5% -> evaluate -> 15% ramp if stable. Need auto-rollback gates.
Maya (ML): Evaluations on Ember prompts: rdx-mini-int8 shows -0.7% acceptability, hallucinations stable. Suggest nightly automated eval + 3 human spot checks/day. Also enable prefix cache for repeated templates.
deploy-bot: Canary staged:
```
model: rdx-mini-int8
traffic: 1%
duration: 24h
gates: nightly_acceptability_drop>1% -> rollback
```
Rory (CS): I'll draft a 2-line customer note. Can someone give me a short tech blurb?
Kai (Eng): Tech blurb: "Short A/B pilot routing low-risk traffic to a compact quantized model to reduce latency variability. High-priority flows remain on current model and fail open to it on any quality signal."
Maya (ML): Also capture flagged examples and include them in the nightly eval set; if 3 flagged escalations appear within 24h -> immediate rollback + PD alert.
Rory (CS): Owners: @Maya evals & spot-checks, @Kai rollout & routing, I handle comms and renewal note. Canary live in eu-central-1 at 09:12 UTC, 1% traffic. Dash: https://dash.internal/redwood/emberlytics/canary (internal)
Rory (CS): Action items: 1) Maya: push nightly eval hook; 2) Kai: add route tag exclusion for escalation; 3) Me: send customer note and schedule 15m sync. Report back after first 24h check. :white_check_mark:
